description: This file defines the 'Note' data class, which models a note entity with properties such as id, title, content, createdAt, and updatedAt. It implements Parcelable to allow passing instances between Android components.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: A data class representing a note, implementing Parcelable for Android inter-process communication.

methods.name: writeToParcel
methods.description: Serializes the Note object into a Parcel.

methods.name: describeContents
methods.description: Returns an indicator of special object types marshaled by this Parcelable, usually 0.
